basic_info.description: Views! Location! Dream Home! Discover this stunning home with breathtaking views, nestled in a quiet cul-de-sac yet conveniently located. This rare floor plan offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms upstairs, with an updated open kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances. The living room features vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and recessed lighting, all complemented by seamless wood flooring. Two rear-facing bedrooms open to an expansive deck with incredible views of the San Bruno Mountains and the bay. The lower level includes an additional bedroom, bathroom, and family room, offering flexible living options and a second deck with magnificent views! The landscaped, low-maintenance backyard is ideal for entertaining and summer BBQs. Located in a desirable neighborhood, enjoy easy access to amenities like H-Mart, Whole Foods, Ocean Ave, Balboa Park, and Stonestown Shopping Center. A commuter's dream with BART, MUNI, Light Rail and highways 280 nearby. Don't miss the chance to make this your dream home.
